# nekoshell

> A Catppuccin terminal rig for macOS: one command installs a zsh config, a prompt, a greeting, a music panel and a plugin set across iTerm2, kitty, Ghostty, Warp and Terminal.app, and one theme switch recolours all of it.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what you get, install, commands, terminals
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the contract for an agent installing or changing nekoshell
- [Install](docs/INSTALL.md): the long install, upgrading, uninstalling, troubleshooting
